summary: Fiola Mare is confirmed at 3050 K Street NW on the Georgetown waterfront. All 64 frozen rows reconcile once against current dinner, lunch, and brunch menus: 45 exact, 9 equivalent/duplicate presentations, and 10 prior-season items. The current union contains 65 unique POC products. Four searches found no formal allergen matrix; direct restaurant-issued ingredient positives are preserved while menu labels and allergy-service language are not converted into unsupported absence or cross-contact claims.
proposedChanges: Replace the prior seasonal projection with the current dinner/lunch/brunch union.
Collapse duplicate seafood-tower, grilled-seafood, potato, chocolate-cake, sole, kampachi, and other equivalent presentations.
Retire prior-season species and dishes absent from current menus and add current seasonal products.
Preserve direct ingredient positives and leave undisclosed allergens unavailable.

findings.finding: The frozen catalog contains multiple duplicate or equivalent presentations across service menus.
Current seasonal menus replace several prior species, crudi, pasta, and brunch dishes.
The restaurant requests allergy disclosure to servers but publishes no formal allergen matrix or cross-contact statement.

coordinatorNotes: Current restaurant-issued dinner, lunch, and brunch pages were treated as the complete seasonal authority.
Alcohol-only beverage products were excluded from POC scope.
No unsupported allergen-negative or cross-contact safety claim was made.
